value.note: Default voice until the workspace sets its own in setup. Say so in every deliverable written with it.
value.tone: Plain, direct and concrete. Talk to the visitor as 'you'.
style_rules: Short sentences. Active voice. Contractions are fine.
No hype verbs: seamless, unlock, supercharge, empower, revolutionize, leverage, elevate, streamline.
No em dashes. No hedging. No 'not just X, Y'.

value.note: Optional. Empty means: write from the brief and mark any product claim it does not source as [needs source].
